name: Stone Putter Dougal

intro.text: The Braemar stone is a big round rock you put from a standing start, with one hand, like a shot. Lift it, don't drop it on your toe, and don't ask why we do this.

win: That was a proper put. Have a seat on the stone. Mind it's heavy.
after: In the old days they'd lift a heavy boulder to prove they were strong enough for the clan. We have progressed to doing it in a field for a rosette.
